The '''Sixth Alsakan Conflict''' was a civil war between [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and the [[Pius Dea]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].

==History==
The war had its backdrop with Alsakan and many of the worlds loyal to it, seceding from the Republic in the [[11,820 BBY|11,820s BBY]].
Worlds along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] who were threatened by the fanatical Pius Dea, pleaded the [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakani]] for protection. Sometime during this vicious conflict, the Alsakani were able to establish secret lines of communication with the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]] and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].

==Aftermath==
Centuries on, Alsakani agents and [[Warship/Legends|warships]] would go on to aid the [[Renunciates]] in their schism with the order and ultimately be a part of the war effort that saw the downfall of the Pius Dea cult.
